title: Algebraic Kunneth formula for tensor products of complexes
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], and let A^\bullet and B^\bullet be cochain complexes of k-vector spaces that are bounded below. Form the total tensor-product cochain complex with (A \otimes_k B)^n = \bigoplus_{p+q=n} A^p \otimes_k B^q and differential d_A \otimes 1 + (-1)^p 1 \otimes d_B on A^p \otimes B^q. For every integer n, the canonical map \bigoplus_{p+q=n} H^p(A) \otimes_k H^q(B) \longrightarrow H^n(A \otimes_k B), sending [a] \otimes [b] to [a \otimes b], is an isomorphism.
